name: Bauernhof-Ferienwohnung Köllnberg
beschreibung: The Bauernhof-Ferienwohnung Köllnberg is located in Schwoich, a charming municipality in the Tyrolean Unterland. The accommodation is part of a working farm. Guests stay in their own private holiday apartment featuring a dining kitchen and a comfortable bedroom. A garden and a sun terrace are also available for guests to relax. The tranquil hillside location commands scenic views of the Kaisergebirge mountains.
